    - sector: Sektor saham (null bila belum tersedia)
    - logo: Link gambar untuk icon perusahaan (null bila belum tersedia)

    Update: Setiap ada perubahan data perusahaan atau IPO Baru

    Get a complete list of all companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX).

    Response:

    - name: Full stock name without the PT prefix
    - sector: Stock sector (null if not available)
    - logo: Image URL for the company icon (null if not available)

    - page: Current page
    - nextPage: Next page number, null on the last page
    - data: UMA list (newest first), each item contains:
      - code: Stock code
      - date: UMA announcement date (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)

    Update: Every time there is a UMA announcement from the Indonesia Stock Exchange

get.description:
Mendapatkan daftar suspensi (penghentian sementara perdagangan) saham dari Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI).

    Respons:
    - totalPage: Total halaman berdasarkan limit
    - page: Halaman saat ini
    - nextPage: Nomor halaman berikutnya, null jika halaman terakhir
    - data: Daftar suspensi (terbaru dulu), tiap item berisi:
      - code: Kode saham
      - start_date: Tanggal mulai suspensi (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
      - end_date: Tanggal suspensi dicabut (format sama dengan start_date), null jika suspensi masih berlaku
      - active: true jika suspensi masih berlaku (end_date null)

    Update: Setiap ada pengumuman suspensi atau pencabutan suspensi dari Bursa Efek Indonesia

    ---
    [English]

    Get the list of stock trading suspensions from the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX).

    Response:
    - totalPage: Total pages based on limit
    - page: Current page
    - nextPage: Next page number, null on the last page
    - data: Suspension list (newest first), each item contains:
      - code: Stock code
      - start_date: Suspension start date (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
      - end_date: Date the suspension was lifted (same format as start_date), null while the suspension is still in effect
      - active: true while the suspension is still in effect (end_date is null)

    Update: Every time there is a suspension or suspension-lift announcement from the Indonesia Stock Exchange

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Nomor halaman, dimulai dari 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Jumlah data per halaman, 1-100.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Filter kode saham, mis. `BBCA` (opsional).

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: `true`: hanya suspensi yang masih berlaku (end_date null); `false`: hanya yang sudah dicabut; kosongkan untuk semua (opsional).

200.description: Berhasil mendapatkan daftar suspensi saham

get.description:
Mendapatkan informasi lengkap dan detail tentang perusahaan berdasarkan kode saham.

    Respons:
    - code: Kode saham
    - name: Nama perusahaan tanpa imbuhan PT
    - address: Alamat kantor pusat perusahaan
    - website: Alamat website perusahaan
    - logo: Link gambar icon perusahaan
    - npwp: Nomor NPWP perusahaan
    - activity: Kegiatan usaha utama perusahaan
    - sector: Sektor saham
    - subsector: Subsektor saham
    - industry: Industri saham
    - subsindustry: Subindustri saham
    - board: Papan pencatatan di BEI (contoh: Utama, Pengembangan)
    - listing_date: Tanggal listing di bursa (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
    - category: Daftar kategori/index yang memuat saham ini (contoh: SYARIAH, IDXENERGY)
    - administration: Biro Administrasi Efek (BAE) perusahaan, null bila tidak tersedia
    - description: Deskripsi profil perusahaan, null bila tidak tersedia
    - ipo_pct: Persentase saham yang dilepas saat IPO (%), null bila tidak tersedia
    - ipo_price: Harga penawaran IPO per lembar (Rupiah), null bila tidak tersedia
    - ipo_share: Jumlah saham yang ditawarkan saat IPO (lembar), null bila tidak tersedia
    - ipo_underwriter: Penjamin emisi IPO, null bila tidak tersedia
    - nominal_price: Nilai nominal per lembar saham (Rupiah), null bila tidak tersedia
    - commissioner: Daftar dewan komisaris (urut nama), tiap item berisi:
      - name: Nama komisaris
      - position: Jabatan (contoh: Independent Commissioner)
    - director: Daftar direksi (urut nama), tiap item berisi:
      - name: Nama direktur
      - position: Jabatan (contoh: President Director, Director)
    - subsidiary: Daftar entitas anak (urut nama), tiap item berisi:
      - name: Nama entitas anak
      - percentage: Persentase kepemilikan perusahaan (%)
    - notation: Notasi khusus yang berlaku pada tanggal notasi terakhir ([] bila tidak ada), tiap item berisi:
      - notation: Kode notasi khusus
      - description: Keterangan arti notasi

    Update: Bulanan sesuai laporan masing-masing perusahaan

    ---
    [English]

    Get complete and detailed information about a company based on stock code.

    Response:
    - code: Stock code
    - name: Company name without the PT prefix
    - address: Company head office address
    - website: Company website
    - logo: Company icon image URL
    - npwp: Company tax ID (NPWP)
    - activity: Company's main business activity
    - sector: Stock sector
    - subsector: Stock subsector
    - industry: Stock industry
    - subsindustry: Stock sub-industry
    - board: IDX listing board (e.g. Utama/Main, Pengembangan/Development)
    - listing_date: Exchange listing date (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
    - category: Categories/indexes that include this stock (e.g. SYARIAH, IDXENERGY)
    - administration: Company's share registrar (BAE), null if not available
    - description: Company profile description, null if not available
    - ipo_pct: Percentage of shares offered at IPO (%), null if not available
    - ipo_price: IPO offering price per share (Rupiah), null if not available
    - ipo_share: Number of shares offered at IPO (shares), null if not available
    - ipo_underwriter: IPO underwriter, null if not available
    - nominal_price: Par value per share (Rupiah), null if not available
    - commissioner: Board of commissioners (sorted by name), each item contains:
      - name: Commissioner name
      - position: Position (e.g. Independent Commissioner)
    - director: Board of directors (sorted by name), each item contains:
      - name: Director name
      - position: Position (e.g. President Director, Director)
    - subsidiary: Subsidiaries (sorted by name), each item contains:
      - name: Subsidiary name
      - percentage: Company's ownership percentage (%)
    - notation: Special notations in effect on the latest notation date ([] if none), each item contains:
      - notation: Special notation code
      - description: Meaning of the notation

    Update: Monthly according to each company's report

get.description:
Mendapatkan daftar saham dengan kenaikan dan penurunan harga terbesar pada hari tertentu, dilengkapi dengan data grafik 5 hari ke belakang.

    Respons:
    - gain / loss: gain = saham dengan perubahan harga > 0 (urut terbesar), loss = perubahan < 0 (urut terkecil), tiap item berisi:
      - code: Kode saham
      - name: Nama perusahaan
      - price: Harga penutupan (Rupiah)
      - change: Perubahan harga harian (%)
      - value: Nilai transaksi (Rupiah)
      - volume: Volume transaksi (lembar)
      - logo: Link gambar icon perusahaan
      - calculated_value: Nilai pengurutan, sama dengan change (%)
      - graph: Data 5 hari bursa terakhir s.d. tanggal yang diminta (urut tanggal naik), tiap item berisi:
        - date: Tanggal (YYYY-MM-DD)
        - value: Perubahan harga harian (%)

    Update: End of Day (EOD) setiap hari setelah jam 18:00 WIB

    Terbatas untuk data 2 tahun terakhir
    Data Awal: 2010-01-01 [ENTERPRISE]

    Catatan:
    - Data tidak tersedia pada hari libur atau weekend
    - Gunakan tanggal hari kerja untuk hasil terbaik
    - Setiap saham dilengkapi dengan data grafik 5 hari

    ---
    [English]

    Get a list of stocks with the largest price increases and decreases on a specific day, complete with 5-day historical graph data.

    Response:
    - gain / loss: gain = stocks with price change > 0 (largest first), loss = change < 0 (most negative first), each item contains:
      - code: Stock code
      - name: Company name
      - price: Closing price (Rupiah)
      - change: Daily price change (%)
      - value: Transaction value (Rupiah)
      - volume: Transaction volume (shares)
      - logo: Company icon image URL
      - calculated_value: Sort value, equal to change (%)
      - graph: Last 5 trading days up to the requested date (ascending), each item contains:
        - date: Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
        - value: Daily price change (%)

    Update: End of Day (EOD) every day after 18:00 WIB

    Limited to data for the last 2 years
    Initial Data: 2010-01-01 [ENTERPRISE]

    Notes:
    - Data not available on holidays or weekends
    - Use business days for best results
    - Each stock includes 5-day graph data

get.description:
Mendapatkan daftar data transaksi running trade realtime/historis untuk kode saham tertentu.

    Respons:
    - totalPage: Total halaman; null saat jam bursa hari ini (data realtime diambil per halaman)
    - page: Halaman saat ini
    - nextPage: Nomor halaman berikutnya; null bila tidak ada halaman berikutnya
    - data: Daftar transaksi, tiap item berisi:
      - order_id: Nomor transaksi (trade number) bursa, angka yang dapat melebihi 2^53
      - buy_order_id: Nomor order sisi beli
      - sell_order_id: Nomor order sisi jual
      - board: Jenis pasar (RG, NG, TN); default RG
      - time: Waktu transaksi (HH:mm:ss WIB)
      - price: Harga transaksi (Rupiah)
      - volume: Volume transaksi (lembar)
      - buyer: Kode broker pembeli (2 karakter)
      - seller: Kode broker penjual (2 karakter)
      - buyer_dom: Tipe investor pembeli (D = domestik, F = asing)
      - seller_dom: Tipe investor penjual (D = domestik, F = asing)
      - type: Jenis aksi berdasarkan order agresor (BUY, SELL, atau UNKNOWN)
      - avg_price: Harga rata-rata (Rupiah); sama dengan price bila tidak tersedia

    ---
    [English]

    Get realtime/historical running trade transaction data for a specific stock code.

    Response:
    - totalPage: Total pages; null for today during trading hours (realtime data is fetched page by page)
    - page: Current page
    - nextPage: Next page number; null when there is no next page
    - data: List of trades, each item contains:
      - order_id: Exchange trade number, a number that can exceed 2^53
      - buy_order_id: Buy-side order number
      - sell_order_id: Sell-side order number
      - board: Market type (RG, NG, TN); defaults to RG
      - time: Trade time (HH:mm:ss WIB)
      - price: Trade price (Rupiah)
      - volume: Trade volume (shares)
      - buyer: Buyer broker code (2 characters)
      - seller: Seller broker code (2 characters)
      - buyer_dom: Buyer investor type (D = domestic, F = foreign)
      - seller_dom: Seller investor type (D = domestic, F = foreign)
      - type: Action type based on the aggressor order (BUY, SELL, or UNKNOWN)
      - avg_price: Average price (Rupiah); equals price when unavailable

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Kode saham emiten yang tercatat di BEI, mis. `BBCA`. Tidak case-sensitive. Daftar kode tersedia di `/analysis/list/stock`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Tanggal data (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Gunakan hari bursa; tanggal libur bursa dapat menghasilkan data kosong.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Nomor halaman, dimulai dari 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Jumlah transaksi per halaman.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Sisi transaksi: `BUY` = match di harga offer (inisiatif beli), `SELL` = match di harga bid (inisiatif jual), `ALL` = seluruh transaksi. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: orderby
parameters.description: Kolom pengurutan: `TIME` = waktu transaksi, `PRICE` = harga, `VOLUME` = volume. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: minimum
parameters.description: Volume minimal transaksi yang ditampilkan, dalam lembar (1 lot = 100 lembar). Berguna untuk menyaring transaksi besar. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: maximum
parameters.description: Volume maksimal transaksi yang ditampilkan, dalam lembar (1 lot = 100 lembar). Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Jenis pasar: `ALL` = seluruh pasar, `RG` = Pasar Reguler, `NG` = Pasar Negosiasi, `TN` = Pasar Tunai. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: pricefrom
parameters.description: Harga terendah transaksi yang ditampilkan (Rupiah). Menampilkan transaksi dengan harga >= `pricefrom`. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: priceto
parameters.description: Harga tertinggi transaksi yang ditampilkan (Rupiah). Menampilkan transaksi dengan harga <= `priceto`. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: timefrom
parameters.description: Jam awal transaksi dalam WIB, format `HH:mm` atau `HH:mm:ss`. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: timeto
parameters.description: Jam akhir transaksi dalam WIB, format `HH:mm` atau `HH:mm:ss`. Tanpa detik, dihitung hingga detik ke-59. Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Arah pengurutan: `ASC` = menaik (terlama lebih dulu), `DESC` = menurun (terbaru lebih dulu). Diabaikan saat jam bursa (tanggal hari ini, 08:45–16:15 WIB pada hari bursa); hanya berlaku pada pengambilan data sehari penuh.

    - low: Lowest price of that minute (Rupiah)
    - close: Closing price of that minute (Rupiah)
    - volume: Trading volume of that minute (shares)
    - freq: Trade frequency of that minute (count); absent in overnight data 23:00-04:00 WIB

get.description:
Mendapatkan data order book untuk saham dengan tanggal terakhir atau data historis pada tanggal/waktu tertentu.

    Mode Pengambilan Data:
    - Realtime: Tanpa parameter date/time - menggunakan data realtime saat jam trading atau data terbaru
    - Historis: Dengan parameter date dan time - mengambil data order book pada timestamp tertentu

    Respons:
    - code: Kode saham (diberi akhiran pasar bila market bukan RG, mis. BBCANG)
    - bid: Daftar level antrian beli, urut dari level 1 (harga terbaik); kunci tiap item memakai nomor level n:
      - bid<n>price: Harga bid level n (Rupiah)
      - bid<n>lot: Jumlah lot pada level n
      - bid<n>freq: Jumlah order pada level n
    - offer: Daftar level antrian jual, urut dari level 1 (harga terbaik); kunci tiap item memakai nomor level n:
      - offer<n>price: Harga offer level n (Rupiah)
      - offer<n>lot: Jumlah lot pada level n
      - offer<n>freq: Jumlah order pada level n

    Parameter Historis:
    - date: Tanggal dalam format YYYY-MM-DD (opsional, minimal 2026-03-25)
    - time: Waktu dalam format HH:MM dengan presisi menit (opsional)

    ---
    [English]

    Get order book data for a stock with the latest date or historical data at specific date/time.

    Data Retrieval Modes:
    - Realtime: Without date/time parameters - uses realtime data during trading hours or the latest data
    - Historical: With date and time parameters - retrieves order book data at specific timestamp

    Response:
    - code: Stock code (with the market suffix when market is not RG, e.g. BBCANG)
    - bid: List of buy queue levels, ordered from level 1 (best price); each item's keys use the level number n:
      - bid<n>price: Bid price at level n (Rupiah)
      - bid<n>lot: Number of lots at level n
      - bid<n>freq: Number of orders at level n
    - offer: List of sell queue levels, ordered from level 1 (best price); each item's keys use the level number n:
      - offer<n>price: Offer price at level n (Rupiah)
      - offer<n>lot: Number of lots at level n
      - offer<n>freq: Number of orders at level n

    Historical Parameters:
    - date: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, minimum 2026-03-25)
    - time: Time in HH:MM format with minute precision (optional)
    - Note: date and time MUST be filled together or both empty

    Update: Real-time (without date/time) or Historical (with date/time)

    - freq: Frekuensi transaksi (kali)

    - offer_freq: Number of orders at the best offer

    - iev: Indicative Equilibrium Volume during pre-opening/pre-closing; 0 for historical data

    Terbatas untuk data 2 tahun terakhir
    Data Awal: 2010-01-01 [ENTERPRISE]

    ---

    Get chart data with technical indicators for stock price analysis in a specific period.

    - value: Indicator value for {indicator} (bdm, foreign, ratio, ritel, freq, lpm, corr_f, par_f, intensity, vol_ratio) on that date

    - nationality: Kewarganegaraan pemegang saham (bisa string kosong)
    - domicile: Domisili pemegang saham
    - scripless: Jumlah saham tanpa warkat/scripless (lembar, string)
    - scrip: Jumlah saham dengan warkat/scrip (lembar, string)
    - total: Total saham yang dimiliki, scripless + scrip (lembar, string)
    - percentage: Persentase kepemilikan terhadap total saham (%); hanya tanggal laporan terbaru, diurutkan dari terbesar

    Update: Bulanan sesuai laporan masing-masing perusahaan

    ---
    [English]

    Get company stock ownership data based on stock code or shareholder name.

    Response:
    - code: Stock code
    - name: Shareholder name (ownership > 1%)
    - type: KSEI investor type (e.g. CP Corporate, ID Individual, IB Financial Institution, IS Insurance, PF Pension Fund, MF Mutual Fund, SC Securities, FD Foundation, OT Other)
    - status: Investor status: LOCAL (domestic) or FOREIGN
    - nationality: Shareholder nationality (may be an empty string)
    - domicile: Shareholder domicile
    - scripless: Number of scripless shares (shares, string)
    - scrip: Number of scrip (certificated) shares (shares, string)
    - total: Total shares held, scripless + scrip (shares, string)
    - percentage: Ownership percentage of total shares (%); latest report date only, sorted largest first

    Update: Monthly according to each company's report

get.description:
Mendapatkan data graf relasi pemegang saham secara dua arah berdasarkan data kepemilikan saham terbaru.

    Respons:
    - nodes: Daftar node graf (saham dan entitas pemegang saham), urut berdasarkan depth, type, lalu label; tiap item berisi:
      - id: ID node, format stock:<KODE> atau entity:<NAMA TERNORMALISASI>
      - type: Jenis node: stock atau entity
      - kind: Klasifikasi node: root (titik awal), stock, atau untuk entitas individual / corporate / institution / other / unknown
      - label: Label tampilan (kode saham atau nama entitas)
      - root: true jika node adalah titik awal pencarian (code/name)
      - depth: Jarak hop dari node root (0 = root, maks sesuai parameter depth 1-4)
      - percentage: Persentase kepemilikan terbesar dari relasi yang terhubung (%); null jika tidak diketahui
      - source_type: Sumber data relasi terpilih: subsidiary, ksei, ubo, atau idx (prioritas sesuai urutan); tidak ada jika node belum punya relasi
      - code: (khusus node stock) Kode saham
      - company_name: (khusus node stock) Nama perusahaan; null jika tidak tersedia
      - logo: (khusus node stock) Link gambar icon perusahaan; null jika tidak tersedia
      - name: (khusus node entity) Nama pemegang saham/entitas
      - entity_type: (khusus node entity) Tipe investor KSEI (mis. CP, ID, IB); null jika tidak tersedia
      - entity_status: (khusus node entity) Status investor (mis. LOCAL/FOREIGN); null jika tidak tersedia
      - nationality: (khusus node entity) Kewarganegaraan; null jika tidak tersedia
      - domicile: (khusus node entity) Domisili; null jika tidak tersedia
    - edges: Daftar relasi kepemilikan saham -> pemegang saham, urut dari persentase terbesar; tiap item berisi:
      - id: ID relasi, format <source>|<target>
      - source: ID node saham (stock:<KODE>)
      - target: ID node pemegang saham (entity:<NAMA TERNORMALISASI>)
      - code: Kode saham yang dimiliki
      - name: Nama pemegang saham
      - normalized_name: Nama pemegang saham huruf kapital dengan spasi dirapikan
      - percentage: Persentase kepemilikan (%); null jika tidak diketahui
      - weight: Bobot relasi untuk visualisasi, sama dengan percentage atau 0.5 jika percentage null
      - source_type: Sumber data relasi: subsidiary (anak perusahaan), ksei, ubo (beneficial owner), atau idx

    Update: Harian sesuai ketersediaan data

    ---
    [English]

    Get bidirectional shareholder relation graph data based on the latest stock ownership data.

    Response:
    - nodes: Graph nodes (stocks and shareholder entities), sorted by depth, type, then label; each item contains:
      - id: Node ID, format stock:<CODE> or entity:<NORMALIZED NAME>
      - type: Node type: stock or entity
      - kind: Node classification: root (starting point), stock, or for entities individual / corporate / institution / other / unknown
      - label: Display label (stock code or entity name)
      - root: true if the node is the search starting point (code/name)
      - depth: Hop distance from the root node (0 = root, up to the depth parameter 1-4)
      - percentage: Largest ownership percentage among connected relations (%); null if unknown
      - source_type: Selected relation data source: subsidiary, ksei, ubo, or idx (priority in that order); absent if the node has no relation yet
      - code: (stock nodes only) Stock code
      - company_name: (stock nodes only) Company name; null if unavailable
      - logo: (stock nodes only) Company icon image URL; null if unavailable
      - name: (entity nodes only) Shareholder/entity name
      - entity_type: (entity nodes only) KSEI investor type (e.g. CP, ID, IB); null if unavailable
      - entity_status: (entity nodes only) Investor status (e.g. LOCAL/FOREIGN); null if unavailable
      - nationality: (entity nodes only) Nationality; null if unavailable
      - domicile: (entity nodes only) Domicile; null if unavailable
    - edges: Ownership relations stock -> shareholder, sorted by largest percentage; each item contains:
      - id: Relation ID, format <source>|<target>
      - source: Stock node ID (stock:<CODE>)
      - target: Shareholder node ID (entity:<NORMALIZED NAME>)
      - code: Code of the stock that is held
      - name: Shareholder name
      - normalized_name: Shareholder name uppercased with whitespace collapsed
      - percentage: Ownership percentage (%); null if unknown
      - weight: Relation weight for visualization, equal to percentage or 0.5 when percentage is null
      - source_type: Relation data source: subsidiary, ksei, ubo (beneficial owner), or idx

    Update: Daily according to data availability

get.description:
Mendapatkan data pergerakan harga indeks sektoral atau saham dalam rentang waktu tertentu.

    Respons:
    - index: Daftar seri harga, tiap item berisi:
      - index: Kode indeks (base = COMPOSITE: IDXENERGY, IDXBASIC, IDXINDUST, IDXNONCYC, IDXCYCLIC, IDXHEALTH, IDXFINANCE, IDXPROPERT, IDXTECHNO, IDXINFRA, IDXTRANS, COMPOSITE) atau kode saham (base lain: item pertama indeks base, lalu saham anggotanya diurutkan dari change terakhir tertinggi)
      - data: Seri harian harga close, tiap item berisi:
        - date: Tanggal (YYYY-MM-DD)
        - value: Harga close yang dinormalisasi ke base 100 pada tanggal pertama (2 desimal)

    Filter Stock (hanya untuk base selain COMPOSITE):
    Anda dapat memfilter saham berdasarkan nilai data saham pada tanggal terakhir dalam range.

    Contoh Filter:
    - filter_column=change&filter_operator=>&filter_value=5 → Saham dengan change > 5%
    - filter_column=value&filter_operator=>=&filter_value=1000000000 → Saham dengan value >= 1 Miliar
    - filter_column=volume&filter_operator=>&filter_value=1000000 → Saham dengan volume > 1 Juta
    - filter_column=foreign&filter_operator=>&filter_value=0 → Saham dengan net foreign buy > 0

    Update: Setiap hari bursa setelah penutupan pasar

    Terbatas untuk data 2 tahun terakhir
    Data Awal: 2010-01-01 [ENTERPRISE]

    Catatan:
    - Ketika base = COMPOSITE: menampilkan data index prices (perilaku default)
    - Ketika base diubah ke index lain (misal IDX30): menampilkan data stock prices dari saham yang termasuk dalam index tersebut
    - Data dinormalisasi ke base 100 untuk memudahkan perbandingan performa

    ---
    [English]

    Get sectoral index or stock price movement data within a specific time range.

    Response:
    - index: List of price series, each item contains:
      - index: Index code (base = COMPOSITE: IDXENERGY, IDXBASIC, IDXINDUST, IDXNONCYC, IDXCYCLIC, IDXHEALTH, IDXFINANCE, IDXPROPERT, IDXTECHNO, IDXINFRA, IDXTRANS, COMPOSITE) or stock code (other base: first item is the base index, then its member stocks sorted by highest latest change)
      - data: Daily close-price series, each item contains:
        - date: Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
        - value: Close price normalized to base 100 on the first date (2 decimals)

    Stock Filter (only for base other than COMPOSITE):
    You can filter stocks based on stock data values on the last date in the range.

    Filter Examples:
    - filter_column=change&filter_operator=>&filter_value=5 → Stocks with change > 5%
    - filter_column=value&filter_operator=>=&filter_value=1000000000 → Stocks with value >= 1 Billion
    - filter_column=volume&filter_operator=>&filter_value=1000000 → Stocks with volume > 1 Million
    - filter_column=foreign&filter_operator=>&filter_value=0 → Stocks with net foreign buy > 0

    Update: Every trading day after market close

    Limited to data for the last 2 years
    Initial Data: 2010-01-01 [ENTERPRISE]

    Notes:
    - When base = COMPOSITE: displays index prices data (default behavior)
    - When base is changed to another index (e.g., IDX30): displays stock prices data from stocks included in that index
    - Data normalized to base 100 to facilitate performance comparison

    - brokers: Kode broker yang dilacak, diurutkan dan digabung koma (misal AG,AK)
    - stock: Kode saham
    - summary: Ringkasan periode, berisi:
      - active: Jumlah hari dengan net value tidak nol
      - total: Akumulasi net value seluruh periode dalam Rupiah
      - avg: Rata-rata net value per hari aktif dalam Rupiah (total / active; 0 jika tidak ada hari aktif)
      - peak: Hari dengan net buy tertinggi, berisi:
        - date: Tanggal (YYYY-MM-DD); null jika tidak ada hari dengan net value positif
        - value: Net value tertinggi dalam Rupiah (0 jika tidak ada)
    - calendar: Data harian (hanya hari yang memiliki transaksi broker, urut tanggal naik), tiap item berisi:
      - date: Tanggal (YYYY-MM-DD)
      - value: Net value harian dalam Rupiah (positif = net buy)
      - buy_value: Nilai beli dalam Rupiah
      - sell_value: Nilai jual dalam Rupiah
      - volume: Net volume dalam lembar
      - buy_volume: Volume beli dalam lembar
      - sell_volume: Volume jual dalam lembar
      - buy_dom: Dominasi beli dalam persen (buy_value / (buy_value + sell_value) x 100, 1 desimal)
      - avg_buy: Harga rata-rata beli dalam Rupiah (2 desimal; 0 jika tidak ada beli)
      - avg_sell: Harga rata-rata jual dalam Rupiah (2 desimal; 0 jika tidak ada jual)
      - avg_net: Harga rata-rata net dalam Rupiah (|net value| / |net volume|, 2 desimal; 0 jika net volume 0)

    Update: End of Day (EOD) setiap hari jam 18:00 WIB

    Track a specific broker's trading activity on a specific stock in daily calendar format.

    Response:
    - brokers: Tracked broker codes, sorted and comma-joined (e.g. AG,AK)
    - stock: Stock code
    - summary: Period summary, contains:
      - active: Number of days with non-zero net value
      - total: Accumulated net value over the whole period in Rupiah
      - avg: Average net value per active day in Rupiah (total / active; 0 when there are no active days)
      - peak: Day with the highest net buy, contains:
        - date: Date (YYYY-MM-DD); null when no day has a positive net value
        - value: Highest net value in Rupiah (0 when none)
    - calendar: Daily data (only days with broker transactions, ascending date), each item contains:
      - date: Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
      - value: Daily net value in Rupiah (positive = net buy)

      - sell_value: Sell value in Rupiah

      - buy_volume: Buy volume in shares
      - sell_volume: Sell volume in shares

      - avg_buy: Average buy price in Rupiah (2 decimals; 0 when there is no buy)
      - avg_sell: Average sell price in Rupiah (2 decimals; 0 when there is no sell)

get.description:
Mendapatkan data intraday inventory chart untuk analisa transaksi dengan detail broker activity pada periode tertentu.

    Respons:
    - price: Data candlestick per interval `range` menit (interval tanpa transaksi dilewati), tiap item berisi:
      - x: Waktu awal interval (format HH:MM), dihitung dari waktu transaksi pertama
      - o: Harga pembukaan pada interval (Rupiah)
      - h: Harga tertinggi pada interval (Rupiah)
      - l: Harga terendah pada interval (Rupiah)
      - c: Harga penutupan pada interval (Rupiah)
      - v: Total transaksi pada interval; dalam lot jika `type=volume`, Rupiah jika `type=value`
    - broker: Daftar broker hingga `total` net buyer teratas lalu `total` net seller teratas (dibatasi `filter` jika diisi), tiap item berisi:
      - code: Kode broker 2 digit
      - name: Nama broker
      - data: Inventory kumulatif broker per interval, tiap item berisi:
        - x: Waktu awal interval (format HH:MM), sama dengan `price.x`
        - y: Net beli dikurangi jual kumulatif hingga interval ini; lot jika `type=volume`, Rupiah jika `type=value` (negatif = distribusi)

    Update: End of Day (EOD) setiap hari jam 18:00 WIB

    Terbatas untuk data 2 tahun terakhir
    Data Awal: 2 bulan terakhir [ENTERPRISE]

    ---
    [English]

    Get intraday inventory chart data for transaction analysis with broker activity details for a specific period.

    Response:
    - price: Candlestick data per `range`-minute interval (intervals without trades are skipped), each item contains:
      - x: Interval start time (HH:MM format), counted from the first trade time
      - o: Opening price in the interval (Rupiah)
      - h: Highest price in the interval (Rupiah)
      - l: Lowest price in the interval (Rupiah)
      - c: Closing price in the interval (Rupiah)
      - v: Total transactions in the interval; in lots if `type=volume`, Rupiah if `type=value`
    - broker: List of up to `total` top net buyers followed by `total` top net sellers (restricted to `filter` if provided), each item contains:
      - code: 2-character broker code
      - name: Broker name
      - data: Broker's cumulative inventory per interval, each item contains:
        - x: Interval start time (HH:MM format), same as `price.x`
        - y: Cumulative net buy minus sell up to this interval; lots if `type=volume`, Rupiah if `type=value` (negative = distribution)

    Update: End of Day (EOD) every day at 18:00 WIB

    Limited to data for the last 2 years
    Initial Data: Past 2 months [ENTERPRISE]

    Response:
    - nodes: List of broker nodes in the diagram, each item contains:

      - source: Buyer broker node (matches `nodes.name`)
      - target: Seller broker node (matches `nodes.name`)
      - value: Total transactions between the two brokers; in shares if `type=volume`, Rupiah if `type=value`

    Update: End of Day (EOD) every day at 18:00 WIB

      - prev_val: Jumlah saham sebelum perubahan (lembar, string)
      - prev_pct: Persentase kepemilikan sebelum perubahan (persen %)
      - next_val: Jumlah saham setelah perubahan (lembar, string)
      - next_pct: Persentase kepemilikan setelah perubahan (persen %)
      - change: Selisih jumlah saham, next_val - prev_val (lembar, string; negatif = berkurang)
      - nationality: Status investor: LOCAL atau FOREIGN

    ---
    [English]

    Get a list of ownership changes above 5% based on exchange reports for a specific period.

    Response:
    - totalPage: Total number of pages (based on `limit`, default 20, max 50)
    - page: Current page number
    - nextPage: Next page number, null on the last page
    - data: List of ownership changes above 5% (last 2 years of data, newest first), each item contains:
      - date: Report date (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)

      - next_pct: Ownership percentage after the change (percent %)
      - change: Share difference, next_val - prev_val (shares, string; negative = decreased)

    Limited to data for the last 2 years
    Initial Data: 2020-01-01 [ENTERPRISE]

      - name: Financial statement account name

      - level: Account depth level in the hierarchy
      - display_order: Account display order
      - values: Account value per period, same order as `columns`, each item contains:
        - col: Period label, e.g. "Q2 2025" or "FY 2024"
        - year: Fiscal year
        - period: Period code (FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4)
        - amount: Account value for that period including rolled-up sub-accounts (Rupiah)

    Update: Real-time according to each company's report

get.description:
Mendapatkan data order book untuk beberapa saham sekaligus dalam 1 request (maksimal 10 kode untuk paket MAX, 25 kode untuk paket ELITE).

    Mode Pengambilan Data:
    - Realtime: Tanpa parameter date/time - menggunakan data realtime; bila belum tersedia menggunakan data terbaru
    - Historis: Dengan parameter date dan time - mengambil data order book pada menit tersebut (WIB); bid dan offer kosong bila tidak ada

    Respons (array, satu item per kode):
    - code: Kode saham (diberi akhiran pasar bila market bukan RG, mis. BBCANG)
    - bid: Daftar level antrian beli, urut dari level 1 (harga terbaik); kunci tiap item memakai nomor level n:
      - bid<n>price: Harga bid level n (Rupiah)
      - bid<n>lot: Jumlah lot pada level n
      - bid<n>freq: Jumlah order pada level n
    - offer: Daftar level antrian jual, urut dari level 1 (harga terbaik); kunci tiap item memakai nomor level n:
      - offer<n>price: Harga offer level n (Rupiah)
      - offer<n>lot: Jumlah lot pada level n
      - offer<n>freq: Jumlah order pada level n

    Parameter Historis:
    - date: Tanggal dalam format YYYY-MM-DD (opsional, data tersedia mulai 2026-03-25)
    - time: Waktu WIB dalam format HH:MM dengan presisi menit (opsional)
    - Catatan: isi date dan time bersamaan untuk data historis; bila hanya salah satu yang diisi, menggunakan data terbaru

    Akses & Batasan:
    - Hanya untuk API Key dengan paket MAX atau ELITE
    - Maksimal kode per request: 10 untuk paket MAX, 25 untuk paket ELITE

    Update: Real-time (tanpa date/time) atau Historical (dengan date/time)

    ---
    [English]

    Get order book data for multiple stocks at once in a single request (up to 10 codes on the MAX plan, 25 on the ELITE plan).

    Data Retrieval Modes:
    - Realtime: Without date/time parameters - uses realtime data; falls back to the latest data when it is not available yet
    - Historical: With date and time parameters - retrieves order book data at that exact minute (WIB); bid and offer are empty when there is none

    Response (array, one item per code):
    - code: Stock code (with the market suffix when market is not RG, e.g. BBCANG)
    - bid: List of buy queue levels, ordered from level 1 (best price); each item's keys use the level number n:
      - bid<n>price: Bid price at level n (Rupiah)
      - bid<n>lot: Number of lots at level n
      - bid<n>freq: Number of orders at level n
    - offer: List of sell queue levels, ordered from level 1 (best price); each item's keys use the level number n:
      - offer<n>price: Offer price at level n (Rupiah)
      - offer<n>lot: Number of lots at level n
      - offer<n>freq: Number of orders at level n

    Historical Parameters:
    - date: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, data available from 2026-03-25)
    - time: WIB time in HH:MM format with minute precision (optional)
    - Note: fill date and time together for historical data; when only one is filled, the latest data is used

    Access & Limits:
    - API Key only, on the MAX or ELITE plans
    - Codes per request: up to 10 on the MAX plan, 25 on the ELITE plan

    Update: Real-time (without date/time) or Historical (with date/time)

get.description:
Mendapatkan data harga intraday ringkas untuk beberapa saham sekaligus dalam 1 request (maksimal 10 kode untuk paket MAX, 25 kode untuk paket ELITE).

    Mode Pengambilan Data:
    - Realtime: Tanpa parameter date - menggunakan data realtime (field yang belum tersedia tidak ditampilkan); bila belum tersedia menggunakan data harian terbaru
    - Historis: Dengan parameter date - mengambil data harian pada tanggal tersebut
    - Catatan: pada data harian, avg, prev, bid_*, offer_*, iep, dan iev bernilai null

    Respons (array, satu item per kode):
    - code: Kode saham (diberi akhiran pasar bila market bukan RG)
    - open: Harga pembukaan (Rupiah)
    - high: Harga tertinggi (Rupiah)
    - low: Harga terendah (Rupiah)
    - close: Harga terakhir/penutupan (Rupiah)
    - avg: Harga rata-rata (Rupiah)
    - volume: Volume transaksi (lembar)
    - freq: Frekuensi transaksi (kali)
    - value: Nilai transaksi (Rupiah)
    - prev: Harga penutupan hari bursa sebelumnya (Rupiah)
    - bid_price: Harga bid terbaik (Rupiah)
    - bid_lot: Volume antrian pada bid terbaik
    - bid_freq: Jumlah order pada bid terbaik
    - offer_price: Harga offer terbaik (Rupiah)
    - offer_lot: Volume antrian pada offer terbaik
    - offer_freq: Jumlah order pada offer terbaik
    - iep: Indicative Equilibrium Price saat pra-pembukaan/pra-penutupan (Rupiah)
    - iev: Indicative Equilibrium Volume saat pra-pembukaan/pra-penutupan

    Akses & Batasan:
    - Hanya untuk API Key dengan paket MAX atau ELITE
    - Maksimal kode per request: 10 untuk paket MAX, 25 untuk paket ELITE

    Catatan:
    - Kode tanpa data hanya berisi code dan close (null)

    Update: Real-time (tanpa date) atau Historical (dengan date)

    ---
    [English]

    Get compact intraday price data for multiple stocks at once in a single request (up to 10 codes on the MAX plan, 25 on the ELITE plan).

    Data Retrieval Modes:
    - Realtime: Without the date parameter - uses realtime data (fields that are not available are omitted); falls back to the latest daily data when it is not available yet
    - Historical: With the date parameter - retrieves daily data on that date
    - Note: in daily data, avg, prev, bid_*, offer_*, iep and iev are null

    Response (array, one item per code):
    - code: Stock code (with the market suffix when market is not RG)
    - open: Opening price (Rupiah)
    - high: Highest price (Rupiah)
    - low: Lowest price (Rupiah)
    - close: Last/closing price (Rupiah)
    - avg: Average price (Rupiah)
    - volume: Trading volume (shares)
    - freq: Trade frequency (count)
    - value: Trading value (Rupiah)
    - prev: Previous trading day's closing price (Rupiah)
    - bid_price: Best bid price (Rupiah)
    - bid_lot: Queued volume at the best bid
    - bid_freq: Number of orders at the best bid
    - offer_price: Best offer price (Rupiah)
    - offer_lot: Queued volume at the best offer
    - offer_freq: Number of orders at the best offer
    - iep: Indicative Equilibrium Price during pre-opening/pre-closing (Rupiah)
    - iev: Indicative Equilibrium Volume during pre-opening/pre-closing

    Access & Limits:
    - API Key only, on the MAX or ELITE plans
    - Codes per request: up to 10 on the MAX plan, 25 on the ELITE plan

    Notes:
    - A code without data contains only code and close (null)

    Update: Real-time (without date) or Historical (with date)

    - volume: Volume transaksi (lembar)
    - freq: Frekuensi transaksi (kali)

    - negative: Jumlah saham yang turun

    - suspend: Jumlah saham yang tidak diperdagangkan/disuspensi

    - market_value: Market value (Rupiah)

    - name: Nama grup: Private (preset milik sendiri), Public (preset dengan scope public), Membership (preset yang dibagikan ke paket Anda)
    - groups: Daftar preset dalam grup, tiap item berisi:
      - id: ID preset (hanya ada di grup Private), dipakai untuk PUT/DELETE /screener/{id}
      - name: Nama preset
      - description: Deskripsi preset (null jika kosong)
      - scope: Daftar visibilitas preset (mis. ["public"] atau nama paket)
      - formula: Formula screener, dapat dijalankan lewat POST /screener/screen
      - category: Daftar kategori indeks yang disaring (mis. ["SYARIAH"]); kosong atau null berarti semua saham
      - profile_name: Nama pembuat preset
      - profile_image: Link foto profil pembuat preset (null jika tidak ada)

    Catatan:
    - Respons selalu berisi tiga grup dengan urutan Private, Public, Membership
    - Perubahan preset milik pengguna lain dapat tampil tertunda hingga 2 jam; perubahan preset Anda sendiri langsung terlihat

    ---
    [English]

    Get the list of screener presets, grouped into your own presets, public presets, and presets shared with your plan.

    Response:
    - name: Group name: Private (your own presets), Public (presets with public scope), Membership (presets shared with your plan)
    - groups: Presets in the group, each item contains:
      - id: Preset ID (only in the Private group), used for PUT/DELETE /screener/{id}
      - name: Preset name
      - description: Preset description (null if empty)
      - scope: Preset visibility list (e.g. ["public"] or plan names)
      - formula: Screener formula, can be run with POST /screener/screen
      - category: Index categories the stocks are filtered to (e.g. ["SYARIAH"]); empty or null means all stocks
      - profile_name: Name of the preset creator
      - profile_image: Profile picture URL of the preset creator (null if none)

    Notes:
    - The response always contains three groups in the order Private, Public, Membership
    - Changes to other users' presets may appear up to 2 hours late; changes to your own presets are visible immediately

get.description:
Mendapatkan daftar saham di watchlist pengguna beserta harga terakhir dan persentase perubahannya terhadap harga acuan yang disimpan.

    Respons:
    - id: ID item watchlist (dipakai pada `PUT /watchlists/{id}`, `PATCH /watchlists/{id}`, dan `DELETE /watchlists`)
    - code: Kode saham
    - note: Catatan pengguna (null bila tidak ada)
    - price: Harga acuan yang disimpan pengguna (Rupiah)
    - name: Nama perusahaan (null bila kode tidak ada di daftar saham)
    - last: Harga terakhir (Rupiah), null bila belum ada data harga
    - change: Persentase perubahan `last` terhadap `price` (%), null bila belum ada data harga
    - group_id: ID grup watchlist (null bila item tanpa grup)

    Update: Pada pukul 08:40-18:30 WIB, `last` dan `change` memakai harga realtime bila tersedia; di luar jam tersebut memakai harga penutupan terakhir.

    Catatan:
    - Isi `group` dengan ID dari field `value` pada `GET /watchlists/group` untuk menampilkan satu grup; isi `null` (atau kosongkan) untuk menampilkan seluruh watchlist dari semua grup.
    - Urutan: item yang terakhir diubah tampil lebih dulu.
    - `last` dan `change` dapat tertunda sehingga tidak selalu mencerminkan harga terkini; menambah, mengubah, atau menghapus item watchlist memuat ulang data.

    ---
    [English]

    Get the stocks in the user's watchlist with their last price and percentage change against the saved reference price.

    Response:
    - id: Watchlist item ID (used by `PUT /watchlists/{id}`, `PATCH /watchlists/{id}` and `DELETE /watchlists`)
    - code: Stock code
    - note: User note (null if none)
    - price: Reference price saved by the user (Rupiah)
    - name: Company name (null if the code is not in the stock list)
    - last: Last price (Rupiah), null if no price data yet
    - change: Percentage change of `last` against `price` (%), null if no price data yet
    - group_id: Watchlist group ID (null if the item has no group)

    Update: Between 08:40 and 18:30 WIB, `last` and `change` use the realtime price when available; outside those hours they use the latest closing price.

    Notes:
    - Set `group` to an ID from the `value` field of `GET /watchlists/group` to show one group; set it to `null` (or omit it) to show the whole watchlist across all groups.
    - Order: most recently updated items first.
    - `last` and `change` may be delayed, so they do not always reflect the current price; adding, updating or deleting a watchlist item reloads the data.

    Respons:

    Catatan:

    ---
    [English]

    Add a new stock to the user's watchlist.

    Response:
    - message: Confirmation message, e.g. "BBCA added to watchlist"

    Notes:
    - group: Group ID from the `value` field of `GET /watchlists/group` (exactly 25 characters).
    - code: Stock code (max 6 characters).
    - price: Reference price in Rupiah (at least 1), used to compute `change` in `GET /watchlists`.
    - note: Optional note (max 150 characters); do not send null, omit the field instead.
    - scope: Array of visibility strings for the watchlist item.
    - A stock code can appear only once across the user's whole watchlist; adding an existing code returns `409`.
    - `group` must be an existing group ID and `code` a listed stock code; otherwise the request fails.

post.description:
Menambahkan satu transaksi BUY atau SELL ke jurnal pengguna, sekaligus memperbarui portofolio. Transaksi BUY menambah lot dan menghitung ulang harga rata-rata (termasuk fee beli) untuk kombinasi kode saham dan broker; transaksi SELL mengurangi lot dan mencatat transaksi terealisasi (profit/loss) yang tampil di `GET /trades`.

    Respons:
    - message: Pesan konfirmasi, mis. "Journal BBCA added successfully." (bahasa mengikuti header Accept-Language)

    Catatan:
    - status default BUY bila tidak dikirim; nilai lain selain BUY/SELL ditolak (422)
    - fee dalam persen dari nilai transaksi (mis. 0.15 = 0,15%)
    - Nilai jurnal = lot x 100 x price, ditambah fee untuk BUY atau dikurangi fee untuk SELL, dibulatkan ke Rupiah
    - SELL hanya bisa dicatat bila sudah ada posisi portofolio untuk kode saham dan broker yang sama; posisi dihapus otomatis saat lot habis
    - note wajib dikirim (boleh null), maksimal 150 karakter

    ---
    [English]

    Add one BUY or SELL transaction to the user's journal and update the portfolio. A BUY adds lots and recalculates the average price (incl. buy fee) for the stock code + broker pair; a SELL reduces lots and records a realized trade (profit/loss) shown in `GET /trades`.

    Response:
    - message: Confirmation message, e.g. "Journal BBCA added successfully." (language follows the Accept-Language header)

    Notes:
    - status defaults to BUY when omitted; anything other than BUY/SELL is rejected (422)
    - fee is a percentage of the transaction value (e.g. 0.15 = 0.15%)
    - Journal value = lot x 100 x price, plus fee for BUY or minus fee for SELL, rounded to Rupiah
    - A SELL requires an existing portfolio position for the same stock code and broker; the position is removed automatically when its lots reach zero
    - note must be sent (may be null), max 150 characters

    Respons:

    - code: Kode saham

    - date: Tanggal transaksi (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
    - lot: Jumlah lot (1 lot = 100 lembar)
    - price: Harga transaksi per lembar (Rupiah)

    ---
    [English]

    Get the user's journal transactions (BUY/SELL) dated between `from` and `to` (inclusive), newest first.

    Response:
    - id: Journal transaction ID (used by `DELETE /journals`)
    - code: Stock code
    - broker: Broker code (2 letters)
    - date: Transaction date (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
    - lot: Quantity in lots (1 lot = 100 shares)
    - price: Transaction price per share (Rupiah)
    - value: Transaction value in Rupiah as a numeric string, incl. fee (BUY = lot x 100 x price + fee; SELL = minus fee), rounded
    - status: Transaction type (BUY or SELL)

Mendapatkan ringkasan transaksi jurnal pengguna dengan tanggal transaksi di antara `from` dan `to` (inklusif): jumlah dan persentase transaksi per jenis, total dan rata-rata nilai, serta rekap per kode saham.

    Respons:
    - top_code: Daftar kode saham, urut dari jumlah transaksi terbanyak
    - total_transaction: Jumlah transaksi pada periode
    - total_buy: Jumlah transaksi BUY
    - total_sell: Jumlah transaksi SELL
    - total_dividend: Jumlah transaksi DIVIDEND
    - total_value: Jumlah nilai seluruh transaksi (Rupiah; BUY dan SELL dijumlahkan)
    - percentage_buy: Persentase transaksi BUY (%)
    - percentage_sell: Persentase transaksi SELL (%)
    - percentage_dividend: Persentase transaksi DIVIDEND (%)
    - average_value: Rata-rata nilai per transaksi (Rupiah)
    - transactions: Rekap per kode saham, urut dari total terbanyak, tiap item berisi:
      - code: Kode saham
      - buy: Jumlah transaksi BUY
      - sell: Jumlah transaksi SELL
      - dividend: Jumlah transaksi DIVIDEND
      - total: Total transaksi kode saham tersebut

    Catatan: Bila tidak ada transaksi pada periode, seluruh angka bernilai 0 dan daftar kosong.

    ---
    [English]

    Get a summary of the user's journal transactions dated between `from` and `to` (inclusive): counts and percentages per transaction type, total and average value, and a per-stock recap.

    Response:
    - top_code: Stock codes, most transactions first
    - total_transaction: Number of transactions in the period
    - total_buy: Number of BUY transactions
    - total_sell: Number of SELL transactions
    - total_dividend: Number of DIVIDEND transactions
    - total_value: Sum of the value of all transactions (Rupiah; BUY and SELL added together)
    - percentage_buy: Share of BUY transactions (%)
    - percentage_sell: Share of SELL transactions (%)
    - percentage_dividend: Share of DIVIDEND transactions (%)
    - average_value: Average value per transaction (Rupiah)
    - transactions: Per-stock recap, highest total first, each item contains:
      - code: Stock code
      - buy: Number of BUY transactions
      - sell: Number of SELL transactions
      - dividend: Number of DIVIDEND transactions
      - total: Total transactions for that stock

    Note: When there are no transactions in the period, every number is 0 and the lists are empty.

Mendapatkan daftar posisi saham yang sedang dimiliki pengguna (hasil pencatatan jurnal), digabung per kode saham dari seluruh broker, urut dari posisi yang terakhir diperbarui.

    Respons:
    - code: Kode saham
    - name: Nama perusahaan, null bila tidak tersedia
    - sector: Sektor saham, null bila tidak tersedia
    - subsector: Subsektor saham, null bila tidak tersedia
    - lot: Total lot yang dimiliki (1 lot = 100 lembar)
    - price: Harga beli rata-rata per lembar, termasuk fee beli (Rupiah)
    - last: Harga penutupan terakhir (Rupiah), null bila belum tersedia
    - value: Nilai modal = lot x 100 x price (Rupiah)
    - change: Perubahan harga terakhir terhadap harga rata-rata (%), null bila last null
    - net: Keuntungan/kerugian belum terealisasi = lot x 100 x (last - price) (Rupiah), null bila last null
    - subrow: Rincian posisi per broker, tiap item berisi:
      - broker: Kode broker (2 huruf)
      - lot: Jumlah lot di broker tersebut
      - price: Harga beli rata-rata per lembar di broker tersebut, termasuk fee beli (Rupiah)
    - child: Jumlah broker pada subrow

    ---
    [English]

    Get the stock positions the user currently holds (built from journal entries), combined per stock code across all brokers, most recently updated first.

    Response:
    - code: Stock code
    - name: Company name, null if not available
    - sector: Stock sector, null if not available
    - subsector: Stock subsector, null if not available
    - lot: Total held lots (1 lot = 100 shares)
    - price: Average buy price per share, incl. buy fee (Rupiah)
    - last: Latest closing price (Rupiah), null if not available yet
    - value: Cost basis = lot x 100 x price (Rupiah)
    - change: Change of the latest price vs the average price (%), null when last is null
    - net: Unrealized profit/loss = lot x 100 x (last - price) (Rupiah), null when last is null
    - subrow: Per-broker breakdown, each item contains:
      - broker: Broker code (2 letters)
      - lot: Lots held at that broker
      - price: Average buy price per share at that broker, incl. buy fee (Rupiah)
    - child: Number of brokers in subrow

get.description:
Mendapatkan ringkasan portofolio pengguna: total nilai modal, nilai pasar, keuntungan/kerugian belum terealisasi, serta komposisi per saham, sektor, dan subsektor.

    Respons:
    - total_value: Total nilai modal (Rupiah)
    - market_value: Total nilai pasar = nilai modal + unrealized (Rupiah)
    - unrealized: Total keuntungan/kerugian belum terealisasi (Rupiah)
    - shares: Komposisi per saham, tiap item berisi:
      - name: Kode saham
      - total_value: Nilai modal saham tersebut (Rupiah)
      - share: Porsi terhadap total nilai modal (%)
    - sector: Komposisi per sektor (saham tanpa sektor tidak dihitung), tiap item berisi:
      - name: Nama sektor
      - total_value: Nilai modal sektor tersebut (Rupiah)
      - share: Porsi terhadap total nilai modal (%)
    - subsector: Komposisi per subsektor (saham tanpa subsektor tidak dihitung), dengan field yang sama seperti sector

    Catatan: Saham yang belum memiliki harga terakhir dihitung dengan unrealized 0. Bila portofolio kosong, seluruh angka bernilai 0 dan daftar kosong.

    ---
    [English]

    Get the user's portfolio summary: total cost basis, market value, unrealized profit/loss, and allocation per stock, sector and subsector.

    Response:
    - total_value: Total cost basis (Rupiah)
    - market_value: Total market value = cost basis + unrealized (Rupiah)
    - unrealized: Total unrealized profit/loss (Rupiah)
    - shares: Allocation per stock, each item contains:
      - name: Stock code
      - total_value: Cost basis of that stock (Rupiah)
      - share: Share of the total cost basis (%)
    - sector: Allocation per sector (stocks without a sector are left out), each item contains:
      - name: Sector name
      - total_value: Cost basis of that sector (Rupiah)
      - share: Share of the total cost basis (%)
    - subsector: Allocation per subsector (stocks without a subsector are left out), same fields as sector

    Note: Stocks without a latest price count with 0 unrealized. For an empty portfolio every number is 0 and the lists are empty.

post.description:
Membuat alert untuk mendapatkan notifikasi ketika saham mencapai formula tertentu.

    Respons:
    - message: Pesan sukses sesuai bahasa (Accept-Language), mis. "Live Alert baru {name} berhasil ditambahkan"

    Catatan:
    - Akun Telegram harus sudah terhubung
    - Batas jumlah alert aktif per paket: TRIAL 2, BASIC 7, PRO 15, ULTRA 30; paket ADVANCE ke atas tidak dibatasi
    - Formula diuji terlebih dahulu; jika tidak valid, alert tidak dibuat dan respons 400 berisi detail kesalahan formula
    - Alert aktif sampai masa langganan Anda berakhir
    - scope bernilai ["public"] jika tidak dikirim; category yang tidak dikirim berarti semua saham

    ---
    [English]

    Create an alert to get notified when stocks meet a given formula.

    Response:
    - message: Success message in the requested language (Accept-Language), e.g. "New Live Alert {name} added successfully"

    Notes:
    - A Telegram account must be connected
    - Active alert limit per plan: TRIAL 2, BASIC 7, PRO 15, ULTRA 30; ADVANCE and higher plans are unlimited
    - The formula is tested first; if it is invalid, the alert is not created and the 400 response contains the formula error details
    - The alert stays active until your subscription expires
    - scope defaults to ["public"] when omitted; an omitted category means all stocks

get.description:
Daftar alert yang sudah dibuat.

    Respons:
    - name: Nama grup alert: Private (alert milik sendiri), Public (alert user lain dengan scope public), Membership (alert user lain yang dibagikan ke paket Anda)
    - groups: Daftar alert aktif dalam grup, tiap item berisi:
      - id: ID alert (hanya ada di grup Private)
      - name: Nama alert
      - description: Deskripsi alert (null jika kosong)
      - every: Interval pengecekan: FOURTY_FIVE_SECONDS, ONE_MINUTE, FIVE_MINUTES, TEN_MINUTES, THIRTY_MINUTES, ONE_HOUR, END_SESSION, END_OF_DAY
      - send_on: Kapan notifikasi dikirim: IN (saham masuk kondisi), OUT (saham keluar kondisi), IN_OUT (keduanya)
      - scope: Daftar visibilitas alert (mis. ["public"] atau nama paket)
      - formula: Formula alert
      - category: Daftar kategori indeks yang disaring (mis. ["SYARIAH"]), null jika semua saham
      - profile_name: Nama pembuat alert
      - profile_image: Link foto profil pembuat alert (null jika tidak ada)

    Catatan:
    - Respons selalu berisi tiga grup dengan urutan Private, Public, Membership
    - Hanya alert yang belum dinonaktifkan dan belum kedaluwarsa yang ditampilkan

    ---
    [English]

    List of created alerts.

    Response:
    - name: Alert group name: Private (your own alerts), Public (other users' alerts with public scope), Membership (other users' alerts shared with your plan)
    - groups: Active alerts in the group, each item contains:
      - id: Alert ID (only in the Private group)
      - name: Alert name
      - description: Alert description (null if empty)
      - every: Check interval: FOURTY_FIVE_SECONDS, ONE_MINUTE, FIVE_MINUTES, TEN_MINUTES, THIRTY_MINUTES, ONE_HOUR, END_SESSION, END_OF_DAY
      - send_on: When the notification is sent: IN (stock enters the condition), OUT (stock leaves the condition), IN_OUT (both)
      - scope: Alert visibility list (e.g. ["public"] or plan names)
      - formula: Alert formula
      - category: Index categories the stocks are filtered to (e.g. ["SYARIAH"]), null for all stocks
      - profile_name: Name of the alert creator
      - profile_image: Profile picture URL of the alert creator (null if none)

    Notes:
    - The response always contains three groups in the order Private, Public, Membership
    - Only alerts that are not disabled and not expired are shown

post.description:
Test alert sebelum membuat alert.

    Respons:
    - success: true jika formula valid dan berhasil dievaluasi; false jika ada error atau pola berisiko
    - formula: Formula yang diuji (setelah normalisasi otomatis, mis. pengaman pembagian)
    - total_stocks: Jumlah saham aktif yang dievaluasi (setelah filter kategori)
    - matched_count: Jumlah saham yang memenuhi formula
    - matched_stocks: Daftar kode saham yang memenuhi formula (maks. 100)
    - sample_results: Contoh hasil evaluasi 5 saham pertama (tidak ada jika formula gagal divalidasi), tiap item berisi:
      - code: Kode saham
      - matched: Status kecocokan saham dengan formula
      - error: Pesan error evaluasi (hanya ada jika gagal)
      - processed_formula: Formula setelah fungsi diproses untuk saham ini
    - warnings: Daftar peringatan formula (tidak ada jika kosong), tiap item berisi:
      - level: Tingkat peringatan: info, warning, error
      - message: Pesan peringatan
      - pattern: Bagian formula yang memicu peringatan
      - suggestion: Saran perbaikan (opsional)
    - error: Pesan error (hanya ada saat gagal); jika success false berisi gabungan peringatan atau pesan error
    - message: Sama dengan error, hanya ada jika success false
    - category_filter: Kategori indeks yang diterapkan (hanya ada jika dikirim)
    - category_filtered_count: Jumlah saham yang lolos filter kategori

    Catatan:
    - Formula yang tidak valid tetap dikembalikan dengan HTTP 200 dan success false; selalu periksa field success

    ---
    [English]

    Test an alert formula before creating the alert.

    Response:
    - success: true if the formula is valid and evaluated successfully; false on error or a high-risk pattern
    - formula: Tested formula (after automatic normalization, e.g. division guards)
    - total_stocks: Number of active stocks evaluated (after the category filter)
    - matched_count: Number of stocks matching the formula
    - matched_stocks: Codes of stocks matching the formula (max 100)
    - sample_results: Evaluation results of the first 5 stocks (absent if the formula fails validation), each item contains:
      - code: Stock code
      - matched: Whether the stock matches the formula
      - error: Evaluation error message (present only on failure)
      - processed_formula: Formula after functions were resolved for this stock
    - warnings: Formula warnings (absent when empty), each item contains:
      - level: Warning level: info, warning, error
      - message: Warning message
      - pattern: Formula fragment that triggered the warning
      - suggestion: Suggested fix (optional)
    - error: Error message (present only on failure); when success is false it holds the joined warnings or the error message
    - message: Same as error, present only when success is false
    - category_filter: Applied index categories (present only when sent)
    - category_filtered_count: Number of stocks passing the category filter

    Notes:
    - An invalid formula is still returned with HTTP 200 and success false; always check the success field

put.description:
Perbarui alert yang sudah dibuat.

    Respons:
    - message: Pesan sukses sesuai bahasa (Accept-Language), mis. "Live Alert {name} berhasil diupdate"

    Catatan:
    - Formula diuji terlebih dahulu; jika tidak valid, alert tidak diubah dan respons 400 berisi detail kesalahan formula
    - Membutuhkan langganan aktif dan akun Telegram yang terhubung; masa aktif alert diperpanjang mengikuti masa langganan
    - Alert yang tidak ditemukan, bukan milik Anda, atau sudah dinonaktifkan menghasilkan 404
    - scope bernilai ["public"] jika tidak dikirim; description dan category yang tidak dikirim akan dikosongkan

    ---
    [English]

    Update a created alert.

    Response:
    - message: Success message in the requested language (Accept-Language), e.g. "Live Alert {name} updated successfully"

    Notes:
    - The formula is tested first; if it is invalid, the alert is not changed and the 400 response contains the formula error details
    - Requires an active subscription and a connected Telegram account; the alert's active period is extended to the subscription expiry
    - An alert that does not exist, is not yours, or is disabled returns 404
    - scope defaults to ["public"] when omitted; an omitted description or category is cleared

get.description:
Mendapatkan daftar semua postingan komunitas Invezgo dengan pagination, diurutkan dari yang terbaru.

    Respons:
    - totalPage: Total halaman berdasarkan limit
    - page: Halaman saat ini
    - nextPage: Nomor halaman berikutnya, null jika halaman terakhir
    - data: Daftar postingan (terbaru dulu), tiap item berisi:
      - id: ID postingan
      - username: Username pembuat postingan
      - content: Isi postingan (HTML)
      - updated_at: Waktu terakhir diubah (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
      - created_at: Waktu dibuat (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
      - visibility: Pengaturan visibilitas postingan
      - image: Link foto profil pembuat (null bila belum diatur)
      - name: Nama tampilan pembuat (null bila belum diatur)
      - verified: Status akun terverifikasi pembuat
      - like: Jumlah suka
      - favorite: Jumlah favorit
      - comment: Jumlah komentar
      - is_like: true bila Anda sudah menyukai postingan
      - is_favorite: true bila Anda sudah memfavoritkan postingan

    Catatan:
    - Hanya postingan yang dapat diakses sesuai cakupan (scope) akun Anda yang ditampilkan

    ---
    [English]

    Get the list of all Invezgo community posts with pagination, sorted newest first.

    Response:
    - totalPage: Total pages based on limit
    - page: Current page
    - nextPage: Next page number, null on the last page
    - data: Post list (newest first), each item contains:
      - id: Post ID
      - username: Author username
      - content: Post content (HTML)
      - updated_at: Last update time (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
      - created_at: Creation time (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
      - visibility: Post visibility setting
      - image: Author profile image URL (null if not set)
      - name: Author display name (null if not set)
      - verified: Whether the author is a verified account
      - like: Number of likes
      - favorite: Number of favorites
      - comment: Number of comments
      - is_like: true if you have liked the post
      - is_favorite: true if you have favorited the post

    Notes:
    - Only posts within your account's access scope are returned

Mendapatkan daftar postingan dan komentar yang Anda favoritkan dengan pagination, diurutkan dari yang terakhir difavoritkan.

    Respons:
    - totalPage: Total halaman berdasarkan limit
    - page: Halaman saat ini
    - nextPage: Nomor halaman berikutnya, null jika halaman terakhir
    - data: Daftar postingan/komentar, tiap item berisi:
      - id: ID postingan atau komentar
      - content: Isi postingan/komentar (HTML)
      - updated_at: Waktu terakhir diubah (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
      - created_at: Waktu dibuat (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
      - image: Link foto profil pembuat (null bila belum diatur)
      - name: Nama tampilan pembuat (null bila belum diatur)
      - username: Username pembuat
      - verified: Status akun terverifikasi pembuat
      - like: Jumlah suka (string angka)
      - favorite: Jumlah favorit (string angka, selalu "1")
      - comment: Jumlah komentar pada postingan, atau jumlah balasan untuk komentar (string angka)
      - is_like: true bila Anda sudah menyukai item
      - is_favorite: true bila Anda sudah memfavoritkan item
      - parent_id: Untuk komentar berisi ID postingan induknya; null untuk postingan
      - favorite_created_at: Waktu Anda memfavoritkan item (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)

    ---
    [English]

    Get the posts and comments you have favorited with pagination, sorted by most recently favorited.

    Response:
    - totalPage: Total pages based on limit
    - page: Current page
    - nextPage: Next page number, null on the last page
    - data: Post/comment list, each item contains:
      - id: Post or comment ID
      - content: Post/comment content (HTML)
      - updated_at: Last update time (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
      - created_at: Creation time (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
      - image: Author profile image URL (null if not set)
      - name: Author display name (null if not set)
      - username: Author username
      - verified: Whether the author is a verified account
      - like: Number of likes (numeric string)
      - favorite: Number of favorites (numeric string, always "1")
      - comment: Number of comments on a post, or replies for a comment (numeric string)
      - is_like: true if you have liked the item
      - is_favorite: true if you have favorited the item
      - parent_id: For a comment, the ID of its parent post; null for a post
      - favorite_created_at: Time you favorited the item (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)

get.description:
Mendapatkan daftar transaksi terealisasi (hasil transaksi SELL di jurnal) milik pengguna dengan tanggal jual di antara `from` dan `to` (inklusif), urut dari tanggal terbaru.

    Respons:
    - id: ID transaksi terealisasi (dipakai untuk `PATCH /trades/{id}` dan `DELETE /trades`)
    - code: Kode saham
    - broker: Kode broker (2 huruf)
    - date: Tanggal jual (DateTime WIB (UTC+7), mis. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Okt 2026 00:00 WIB; akhiran Z bukan berarti UTC, jangan dikonversi zona waktunya)
    - lot: Jumlah lot yang dijual (1 lot = 100 lembar)
    - buy_price: Harga beli rata-rata per lembar saat penjualan, termasuk fee beli (Rupiah)
    - sell_price: Harga jual per lembar (Rupiah)
    - buy_value: Nilai beli = lot x 100 x buy_price, dibulatkan (Rupiah)
    - sell_value: Nilai jual = lot x 100 x sell_price, sebelum fee jual (Rupiah)
    - net: Keuntungan/kerugian bersih = sell_value - fee jual - buy_value, dibulatkan (Rupiah)
    - percent: Persentase keuntungan/kerugian harga = (sell_price - buy_price) / buy_price x 100, 4 desimal (%)
    - status: PROFIT, LOSS, atau BEP berdasarkan net
    - note: Catatan pengguna, null bila kosong

    ---
    [English]

    Get the user's realized trades (from SELL journal entries) with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive), newest first.

    Response:
    - id: Realized trade ID (used by `PATCH /trades/{id}` and `DELETE /trades`)
    - code: Stock code
    - broker: Broker code (2 letters)
    - date: Sell date (WIB (UTC+7) DateTime, e.g. 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z = 16 Oct 2026 00:00 WIB; the Z suffix does not mean UTC, do not convert the time zone)
    - lot: Sold lots (1 lot = 100 shares)
    - buy_price: Average buy price per share at the time of the sale, incl. buy fee (Rupiah)
    - sell_price: Sell price per share (Rupiah)
    - buy_value: Buy value = lot x 100 x buy_price, rounded (Rupiah)
    - sell_value: Sell value = lot x 100 x sell_price, before sell fee (Rupiah)
    - net: Net profit/loss = sell_value - sell fee - buy_value, rounded (Rupiah)
    - percent: Price gain/loss = (sell_price - buy_price) / buy_price x 100, 4 decimals (%)
    - status: PROFIT, LOSS or BEP based on net
    - note: User note, null if empty

get.description:
Mendapatkan ringkasan performa transaksi terealisasi pengguna dengan tanggal jual di antara `from` dan `to` (inklusif): jumlah transaksi profit/loss/BEP, total nilai, win rate, serta transaksi terbaik dan terburuk.

    Respons:
    - top_code: Daftar kode saham, urut dari jumlah transaksi terbanyak
    - total_transaction: Jumlah transaksi terealisasi pada periode
    - total_profit: Jumlah transaksi PROFIT
    - total_loss: Jumlah transaksi LOSS
    - total_bep: Jumlah transaksi BEP (impas)
    - total_buy_value: Total nilai beli (Rupiah)
    - total_sell_value: Total nilai jual (Rupiah)
    - total_net: Total keuntungan/kerugian bersih (Rupiah)
    - win_rate: Persentase transaksi PROFIT (%)
    - loss_rate: Persentase transaksi LOSS (%)
    - bep_rate: Persentase transaksi BEP (%)
    - top_win_value: Transaksi PROFIT dengan net terbesar, berisi:
      - code: Kode saham (string kosong bila tidak ada)
      - value: Nilai net (Rupiah), 0 bila tidak ada
    - top_loss_value: Transaksi LOSS dengan kerugian net terbesar, berisi code dan value (Rupiah)
    - top_win_percent: Transaksi PROFIT dengan persentase terbesar, berisi code dan value (%)
    - top_loss_percent: Transaksi LOSS dengan persentase terendah, berisi code dan value (%)

    Catatan: Bila tidak ada transaksi pada periode, seluruh angka bernilai 0, top_code kosong, dan setiap top_* bernilai {"code": "", "value": 0}.

    ---
    [English]

    Get a performance summary of the user's realized trades with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive): profit/loss/BEP counts, totals, win rate, and the best and worst trades.

    Response:
    - top_code: Stock codes, most trades first
    - total_transaction: Number of realized trades in the period
    - total_profit: Number of PROFIT trades
    - total_loss: Number of LOSS trades
    - total_bep: Number of BEP (break-even) trades
    - total_buy_value: Total buy value (Rupiah)
    - total_sell_value: Total sell value (Rupiah)
    - total_net: Total net profit/loss (Rupiah)
    - win_rate: Share of PROFIT trades (%)
    - loss_rate: Share of LOSS trades (%)
    - bep_rate: Share of BEP trades (%)
    - top_win_value: PROFIT trade with the largest net, contains:
      - code: Stock code (empty string if none)
      - value: Net value (Rupiah), 0 if none
    - top_loss_value: LOSS trade with the largest net loss, contains code and value (Rupiah)
    - top_win_percent: PROFIT trade with the highest percent, contains code and value (%)
    - top_loss_percent: LOSS trade with the lowest percent, contains code and value (%)

    Note: When there are no trades in the period, every number is 0, top_code is empty and each top_* is {"code": "", "value": 0}.

get.description:
Mendapatkan data grafik harian keuntungan/kerugian terealisasi pengguna dengan tanggal jual di antara `from` dan `to` (inklusif), beserta nilai kumulatifnya dan harga penutupan indeks pembanding pada hari yang sama. Hanya hari yang memiliki transaksi terealisasi yang ditampilkan, urut tanggal naik.

    Respons:
    - date: Tanggal transaksi (YYYY-MM-DD, WIB)
    - net: Total keuntungan/kerugian bersih pada hari tersebut, 2 desimal (Rupiah)
    - cumulative_net: Akumulasi net sejak awal periode, 2 desimal (Rupiah)
    - close: Harga penutupan indeks pembanding pada hari tersebut, 2 desimal; null bila data indeks tidak tersedia

    Catatan:
    - Parameter `code` berisi kode indeks pembanding (mis. COMPOSITE)
    - Bila `code` dikirim kosong (`code=`), setiap hari dapat muncul lebih dari sekali, satu baris per indeks yang memiliki data pada hari itu

    ---
    [English]

    Get daily chart data of the user's realized profit/loss with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive), with its running total and the comparison index close on the same day. Only days with realized trades are returned, in ascending date order.

    Response:
    - date: Trade day (YYYY-MM-DD, WIB)
    - net: Net profit/loss on that day, 2 decimals (Rupiah)
    - cumulative_net: Running total of net since the start of the period, 2 decimals (Rupiah)
    - close: Comparison index close on that day, 2 decimals; null if no index data

    Notes:
    - The `code` parameter is the comparison index code (e.g. COMPOSITE)
    - When `code` is sent empty (`code=`), a day can appear more than once, one row per index that has data on that day
